_comment: Approximate crosswalk from MINC-2500 material categories (ground truth) to the closest Matador-C1 leaf materials. Used to score the C1 (Matador-trained) classifier on MINC patches: a C1 prediction is counted correct if its predicted leaf is in the accepted list for the patch's true MINC label. Mappings are best-effort and intentionally conservative; MINC categories with no reasonable Matador equivalent are omitted (the eval reports them as 'uncovered'). The MINC-trained classifier does NOT use this file (its labels match the GT directly).
